title: MV June Aster death toll rises to 77 after crew dies in Culion hospital

blocks.text: The death toll from the fire aboard the passenger vessel MV June Aster in Coron, Palawan, has risen to 77 after a male crew member who was among those rescued from the ship died Tuesday afternoon at Culion Sanitarium and General Hospital.
